label: Ontology terms and their ancestors per pathway
description: Lists for every pathway of one species (to avoid timeouts) its ontology annotations, each column a set of values separated by a vertical bar (labels can contain commas). Results are split by ontology and retrieve IDs, labels, and upstream terms for the Pathway Ontology (PW), Human Disease Ontology (DOID), and Cell Ontology (CL).
query:
PREFIX dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX wp: <http://vocabularies.wikipathways.org/wp#>

SELECT
  ?wpid
  (STR(?titleLit) AS ?title)
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?pwTerm;       separator=" | ") AS ?pathwayOntologyIds)
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?pwLabel;      separator=" | ") AS ?pathwayOntologyLabels)
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?pwAncestor;   separator=" | ") AS ?pathwayOntologyAncestors)
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?doidTerm;     separator=" | ") AS ?diseaseOntologyIds)
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?doidLabel;    separator=" | ") AS ?diseaseOntologyLabels)
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?doidAncestor; separator=" | ") AS ?diseaseOntologyAncestors)
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?clTerm;       separator=" | ") AS ?cellTypeOntologyIds)
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?clLabel;      separator=" | ") AS ?cellTypeOntologyLabels)
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?clAncestor;   separator=" | ") AS ?cellTypeOntologyAncestors)

WHERE {
  VALUES ?species { "Homo sapiens" }

  ?pathwayRDF a wp:Pathway ;
      dcterms:identifier ?wpid ;
      dc:title ?titleLit ;
      wp:organismName ?species .

  OPTIONAL {
    VALUES ?ontologyPrefix {
      "http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/PW_"      # Pathway Ontology
      "http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/DOID_"    # Human Disease Ontology
      "http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_"      # Cell Ontology
    }

    ?pathwayRDF wp:ontologyTag ?ontoTag .
    FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?ontoTag), STR(?ontologyPrefix)))
    ?ontoTag a owl:Class ; rdfs:label ?ontoLabel .
    BIND(REPLACE(STR(?ontoTag), "^.*/", "") AS ?ontoTerm)

    OPTIONAL {
      ?ontoTag rdfs:subClassOf* ?ancestor .
      ?ancestor a owl:Class ; rdfs:label ?ancestorName .
    }

    BIND(IF(STRSTARTS(?ontoTerm, "PW_"),   ?ontoTerm,     ?unbound) AS ?pwTerm)
    BIND(IF(STRSTARTS(?ontoTerm, "PW_"),   ?ontoLabel,    ?unbound) AS ?pwLabel)
    BIND(IF(STRSTARTS(?ontoTerm, "PW_"),   ?ancestorName, ?unbound) AS ?pwAncestor)
    BIND(IF(STRSTARTS(?ontoTerm, "DOID_"), ?ontoTerm,     ?unbound) AS ?doidTerm)
    BIND(IF(STRSTARTS(?ontoTerm, "DOID_"), ?ontoLabel,    ?unbound) AS ?doidLabel)
    BIND(IF(STRSTARTS(?ontoTerm, "DOID_"), ?ancestorName, ?unbound) AS ?doidAncestor)
    BIND(IF(STRSTARTS(?ontoTerm, "CL_"),   ?ontoTerm,     ?unbound) AS ?clTerm)
    BIND(IF(STRSTARTS(?ontoTerm, "CL_"),   ?ontoLabel,    ?unbound) AS ?clLabel)
    BIND(IF(STRSTARTS(?ontoTerm, "CL_"),   ?ancestorName, ?unbound) AS ?clAncestor)
  }
}
GROUP BY ?wpid ?titleLit
